title.zh: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
title.en: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace

current_state.zh: A maliciously modified copy of the Claude Code VS Code extension was published on Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours, backdooring affected users by appending an attacker-controlled SSH key to their authorized_keys files.
current_state.en: A maliciously modified copy of the Claude Code VS Code extension was published on Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours, backdooring affected users by appending an attacker-controlled SSH key to their authorized_keys files.
